feature: Buying credits: the plan card, K1 to K6 and R3 (U3b)
note: Plan `2026-10-17-buying-credits-ui.md`, PR U3b; extends `buying-credits.json` (U1) and `buying-credits-u2.json`. ONE account STATE per run, like U2: the sheet reads whatever the signed-in account holds, so a run is repeated with the account reseeded between runs (no subscription; an `active` subscription with 74 plan credits; `active` with cancel_at_period_end and a period end 20 days out (K3); the same with the period end 2 days out and a plan lot expiring then (K4, and the chip line); `past_due`; a `canceled` subscription with its plan lots expired and two plan history rows (K6)). Every row waits on `data-plan-state`, so a run in the wrong state times out, and that time-out IS the evidence the state is absent. PRECONDITION: `PAYMENTS_ENABLED` on for the account. The page READS only: no row presses Subscribe, Cancel, Keep or Update card, which write a real Stripe Session or subscription (the signed-fixture probe and the component tests cover the presses; `pnpm probe:plan-cancel` the server half). `credits-u3-r3` needs a Checkout Session of the account's own for a plan, created on test mode and passed as `PLAN_SESSION_ID`; without one the row times out, which is the good failure. `credits-u3-chip-line` uses the shell's `openAccount` verb, as U2's does, and draws only in the K4 state. Low Sun is the app default; Witching Hour and First Frost are checked once here with `THEME=<key>` (plan, Themes).

rows.label: /credits: K1, no plan: the offer with its four fine-print lines before Subscribe, above the pack
/credits: K2, subscribed: Your plan with the renewal date, Cancel plan, what it does, Update card
/credits: K3, cancelled in the paid month: Ends date, expiry restated, Keep my plan
/credits: K4, cancelled and within 3 days: border and words in --warning
/credits: K5, past due: payment didn't go through, Update card leads, Cancel plan as text
/credits: K6, expired: the K1 offer again, the months kept in history
/credits?checkout=done&session_id=<the account's own plan Session>: R3, Plan started with the renewal date, Cancel plan below
Account menu open: the expiring chip's line for the cancelled plan (K4's twin, L7 and the chip proven live)
